// diagnostic

E1233

In-repo dependency `{name}` is outside the workspace.

What

In-repo dependency `{name}` is outside the workspace.

Why

A member's `package.jet` depends on another in-repo package, but that package is not in the source repo's `workspace.jet` member index, so the sparse checkout can't include it (D-MONOREF1).

Fix

add the dependency to the source repo's `workspace.jet` `members:`, or depend on it as an external `package@source` ref.
